# ReplayFastLanczos

Module: **core** · directory: `src/Programs` · binary: `src/Programs/ReplayFastLanczos`

```text
ReplayFastLanczos, version 0.01

Usage: ReplayFastLanczos [options] 

Options:

Lanczos options:
    -p, --lanczos-precision : define Lanczos precision for eigenvalues (0 if automatically defined by the program) (default value = 0)
    -s, --lanczos-shift : define the shift applied to the hamiltonian during the original Lanczos process (default value = 0)
    -e, --eigenstate : compute the ground state
    -o, --ground-filename : name of the file where the ground state has to be stored (in default ground.vec.XX, with XX=nbr iteration)
    -n, --nbr-iter : set a new number of lanczos iteration (0 if the one of the lanczos.dat has to be kept) (default value = 0)
    -c, --complex-lanczos : indicate whether a complex Lanczos algorithm was used
    --projector-lanczos : projectors were used in Lanczos algorithm
    --block-lanczos : use block Lanczos algorithm

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

tools options:
    --use-lapack : use LAPACK libraries instead of DiagHam libraries

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
